nodes.description: Private address state variable in Ownable that stores the current owner of the contract.
mapping(address => Stake) holding each staker's stake record (exists, createdOn, initialAmount, compound, lockupPeriod, withdrawn, referrer).
Aggregate amount of tokens currently staked, mutated in createStake and finishStake.
mapping(uint8 => uint256) counting the number of stakes per lockup period, modified with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Accumulated admin fee balance withdrawable by the owner through _adminWithdraw.
IERC20 token contract reference used for all transfers in StakingPool.
mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => ROI)) private year/month to ROI configuration.
Total number of currently open stakes.
Address receiving burnt fee tokens in finishStake.
Owner controlled boolean flag enabling the 1-month lockup period.
Public entry point that pulls tokens via transferFrom, records a new Stake for msg.sender and pays the referrer bonus.
Public function allowing non-compounding stakers to withdraw accrued rewards; performs an external token transfer.
Public function closing a stake, computing fees/penalties, burning tokens and transferring the remainder to the staker.
Public view returning true when msg.sender or tx.origin equals _owner; the onlyOwner modifier depends on it.
Owner-restricted function delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal function that writes the new owner address into _owner.
Owner-restricted function that zeroes adminCanWithdraw and transfers the amount to msg.sender.
Public view resolving the ROI for a month/year/lockup combination from rois or the DEFAULT_ROI constants.
Internal pure reward computation using exponentiation for compounding stakes.
Internal view comparing the stake creation timestamp plus half the lockup against the current block timestamp.
Owner-restricted configuration function toggling the enabled lockup periods.
Owner-restricted function writing ROI values into the rois mapping for a current or future month.
Public view computing accrued rewards for non-compounders up to a supplied timestamp.
Ownable constructor assigning msg.sender as the initial owner.
Public view validating a lockup period against the isValidLockup flags.
Caller controlled address used as stake key, owner check and transfer recipient.
Block timestamp (now) used for stake creation, reward accrual and finish-time checks.
Transaction origin checked in isOwner, enabling phishing based owner impersonation.
External IERC20 token.transfer(msg.sender, ...) inside withdraw before finalized accounting.
External IERC20 transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), ...) inside createStake, executed before state is written.
External token.transfer to BURN_ADDRESS inside finishStake executed before stakes[msg.sender] is deleted.
Raw unchecked arithmetic totalByLockup[_lockupPeriod] += 1 in createStake.
Exponentiation (roi.add(10000) ** 10 / ** totalDays) in calculateRewards, overflow prone on Solidity 0.6.
External token.transfer(msg.sender, ...) inside _adminWithdraw.
Unchecked uint8 subtraction uint8 totalDays = _todayDay - _initial.day in calcPartialRewardsForInitialMonth.
Raw arithmetic stakes[_referrer].initialAmount += amountToIncrease in createStake.
Parameter _amount of createStake: staked amount supplied by the caller.
Parameter _lockupPeriod of createStake selecting 1/2/3/6 month lockup.
Parameter _compound of createStake deciding reinvestment behaviour.
Parameter _referrer of createStake receiving the referral bonus.
Local variable total in withdraw holding the amount to transfer out.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership/_transferOwnership, the new owner address.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes and writes stakes[msg.sender] and receives the referral logic in createStake.
msg.sender selects the stake and is the recipient of the token transfer in withdraw.
msg.sender selects the stake to finish and receives the payout in finishStake.
msg.sender is compared against _owner in isOwner controlling the onlyOwner modifier.
tx.origin is compared against _owner in isOwner, allowing phished accounts to pass the ownership check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which requires isOwner().
_adminWithdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which requires isOwner().
_setValidLockups is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which requires isOwner().
_setRoi is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which requires isOwner().
transferOwnership delegates the actual ownership change to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the new address into the _owner state variable.
The Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to initialize the owner.
The Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into _owner.
block.timestamp (now) is stored as stake.createdOn in createStake, creating timestamp dependency.
withdraw passes now into getPartialToWidthdrawForNotCompounders, tying reward payout to block.timestamp.
finishStake compares now against the computed finish timestamp to gate payouts.
_isFirstHalf compares now against createdOn plus half the lockup, deciding the penalty applied.
getPartialToWidthdrawForNotCompounders parses _now/now to compute accrued rewards.
_setRoi derives today_year/today_month from now to validate the requested month.
createStake writes the new Stake into the stakes mapping after the external transferFrom call.
createStake performs the external token.transferFrom call to pull user funds.
The external token contract can re-enter createStake during transferFrom while stakes[msg.sender] is still unset.
createStake executes the unchecked totalByLockup[_lockupPeriod] += 1 increment.
createStake executes the raw stakes[_referrer].initialAmount += amountToIncrease addition.
createStake validates the lockup period through _isValidLockupPeriod.
withdraw loads the Stake from the stakes mapping and updates stake.withdrawn.
withdraw performs the external token.transfer call to the staker.
The external token transfer can re-enter withdraw before accounting is consistent.
withdraw stores the computed payout in the local variable total.
finishStake reads stakes[msg.sender] and only deletes it after external calls.
finishStake performs an external token.transfer to BURN_ADDRESS before deleting the stake, exposing a reentrancy window.
The external burn transfer can re-enter finishStake while the staker record still exists.
finishStake credits the admin fee into adminCanWithdraw.
finishStake adjusts totalStaked when closing a stake.
finishStake decrements totalByLockup[stake.lockupPeriod] using SafeMath.
finishStake decrements the totalStakes counter.
_adminWithdraw reads and resets the adminCanWithdraw balance.
_adminWithdraw uses the token state variable for the payout transfer.
_adminWithdraw performs the external token.transfer to msg.sender.
getRoi reads configured values from the rois mapping before falling back to defaults.
_setRoi writes ROI entries into the rois mapping under owner control.
_setValidLockups writes the isValidLockup flags that gate allowed lockup periods.
_isValidLockupPeriod reads isValidLockup1 to validate the requested period.
getPartialToWidthdrawForNotCompounders queries getRoi for each accrual month.
getPartialToWidthdrawForNotCompounders calls calculateRewards to size the rewards.
getPartialToWidthdrawForNotCompounders path executes the uint8 subtraction totalDays = _todayDay - _initial.day.
calculateRewards performs exponentiation on roi.add(10000) which can overflow unchecked.
The _amount parameter feeds the staking and token transfer logic of createStake.
The _lockupPeriod parameter selects the lockup and is validated in createStake.
The _compound parameter decides the compounding branch in createStake.
The _referrer parameter determines the referral bonus credited in createStake.
The newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is the privileged address being promoted.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written into _owner by _transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is a purely local input of createStake and should be folded into the function node as an attribute.
_lockupPeriod only parameterizes createStake stake creation and lockup validation.
_compound only selects the compounding branch inside createStake.
_referrer only affects the referral bonus path inside createStake.
The local total is a temporary payout buffer computed and consumed inside withdraw.
newOwner is the direct input of the ownership transfer flow and should merge into transferOwnership.
